chalisa.do1: Victory, victory to Mother Śītalā. Whoever meditates on you, his heart becomes pure and cool, and his intellect, strength and knowledge blossom.
chalisa.do2: Śītalā, dweller in every heart, your radiance is cool. In the cool shade the Mother hangs a cradle and rocks it.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Śītalā Bhavānī. Victory to the mother of the world, a mine of every virtue. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Your power shines in every home, adorned like the full autumn moon. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: The body burning with smallpox you make cool, and you take away all its pain. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Mother Śītalā, your auspicious name comes to the help of all in hard times. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: You are the remover of grief, Śaṅkarī, Bhavānī, protector of children's lives and giver of happiness. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: A pure broom and a water-pot grace your hands; on your forehead a splendour shines like the sun. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: The sixty-four yoginīs sing with you and play the vīṇā, cymbals and mṛdaṅga. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Lord Bhairava displays his dance; not even Śeṣa and Śiva easily find your end. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Blessed, blessed are you, the nurturing mother, the great queen; gods, men and sages proclaim your fair fame. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: There was a huge demon, Visphoṭaka, in the form of flame and mighty in strength. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: He entered house after house and no one could protect them; taking the form of disease, he devoured children. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: A great outcry arose throughout the world, when no one could avert the calamity. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Then the Mother took on a wondrous form, holding a broom and a winnowing basket in her hands. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: She seized Visphoṭaka with her hand and struck him with a pestle in many ways. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: He pleaded in many ways: Mother, I did not rightly know you at all. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Mother, I shall not now go into anyone's house; where there is impurity, all its sorrow will be taken away. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Burning bodies will become cool, and the dread terror of smallpox will perish. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Worship of Śrī Śītalā brings welfare: the Lord has spoken this true word. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Brother, the house where there is fear of smallpox should worship the Goddess; this is the remedy. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Let it have a kalaśa of Śītalā adorned, and have a Brahmin recite the text according to the rite. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Śītalā, you alone are the mother of the world, you alone the father, the giver of joy to the world. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: You alone are the sustainer of the world, giver of joy to those who serve you. Salutations, I bow to you, Goddess Śītalā. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Salutations to you who give happiness and take away sorrow; salutations, salutations to you, the boat that carries the world across. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Salutations, salutations to you, revered by the three worlds, uprooter of sorrow, poverty and the rest. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: You are Śrī Śītalā, Śeṛhalā, Mahalā, Ruṇalīhyuṇanī and Mother Maṃdalā. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: You bear a sky-clad body; your mount of five names looks splendid. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: It is the donkey: rāsabha, khara, vaiśākha-sunandana, gardabha, the uprooter of dūrvā roots. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Whoever remembers Mother Śītalā, at that very remembrance all his sorrows flee far away. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Whatever swelling of the throat, goitre or the like there may be, for it there is no mantra and no medicine. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: There is only the worship of the Mother; there is no other means. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Whoever comes to the Mother's refuge with firm faith becomes fearless and gains the fruit his heart desires. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: The leper gains a spotless body, and the blind man sees with his own eyes. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: The childless woman gains a son, and one poor from birth becomes rich. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Singing the virtues of Mother Śītalā, even the mute has been seen composing verse. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Let no one have any doubt in this: throughout the world it is the Mother's drum alone that sounds. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Says Rāmasundara Prabhudāsa: on the bank, to the east of Prayāga, close by, ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Purī Tivārī is my home, at Kakarā on the bank of the Gaṅgā, by Durvāsā's hermitage. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Now it grows late; I call to you, Mother, watching the road for your grace. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: This perishable one lies here with his hope set on you; protect me, Mother Śītalā. ॥39॥
